description: Fixtures for the v0.1 JSON span decoder. Each case's expected value is what the trace-agent's receiver decodes from the body: decodeConvertedTracerPayload on /v0.1/spans with Content-Type application/json (format json) or text/plain (format any), with no tracer headers and no container. traceChunksFromSpans builds the chunks from a map, so their order is random: compare them in any order. Spans keep their order within a chunk; attribute maps are unordered. Cases never promote different payload fields from two chunks, since which chunk wins depends on that order. Doubles are Go's shortest formatting of the float64. Errors are classified as httpDecodingError tags them (tag) and as handleTracesV1 counts the dropped traces (reason). Generated by test/trace-agent-oracle/regenerate.sh; don't edit by hand.
